theme: Rho GTPase-driven actin remodelling for cell migration
core_role: The shared pathways are the actin filament architecture controls (crosslinking, severing, capping, bundling, network formation, restraint of Arp2/3 nucleation) that serve as the cytoskeletal effector machinery Rho-family GTPases tune to build protrusions, set cell shape and polarity, and drive cell motility.

theme: Nuclear RNA processing: 3'-end formation, splicing, snRNA maturation
core_role: The shared pathways are mRNA 3'-end formation (cleavage and polyadenylation, histone stem-loop processing, Pol II termination) and its regulation, framed as the terminal maturation step of nuclear pre-mRNA processing alongside splicing, snRNP biogenesis and nuclear RNA surveillance.

theme: Axon guidance by repulsive and attractive cues
core_role: The shared pathways are the repulsive guidance arm (semaphorin-3A and ephrin signalling, growth cone collapse, microtubule destabilization, fasciculation) used within axon pathfinding alongside netrin, Slit/Robo and L1 cues acting through Rho GTPases.

theme: Netrin, Slit/Robo and ephrin axon guidance signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are netrin-driven control of axon extension and chemorepulsion, the netrin branch of a guidance-receptor network that also includes Slit/Robo and ephrin repulsion converging on Rho GTPases.

theme: Kidney nephron development: glomerulus and tubule segments
core_role: The shared pathways are glomerular development (mesangial, endothelial, epithelial and vascular components), the filtering-corpuscle part of nephron morphogenesis alongside development of tubule segments and control of renal progenitor proliferation.

theme: Recombinational repair of replication-associated DNA damage
core_role: The shared pathways are repair DNA synthesis and sister-chromatid-exchange double-strand break repair, framed as homologous recombination used to rescue broken or stalled replication forks (fork reversal, strand invasion, crosslink and camptothecin damage).

theme: Regulation of mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation and ROS
core_role: The shared pathways are tuning of the electron transport chain, ATP synthesis and respiration while limiting ROS, framed as mitochondrial bioenergetic control that shapes cell stress, drug and hypoxia responses and apoptosis.

theme: Threonine, glycine and small amino acid catabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are threonine catabolism to glycine and glyoxylate metabolism, read as amino acid degradation and interconversion within organic-acid metabolism, extended by alanine metabolism.

theme: Protein quality control: proteasome and selective autophagy
core_role: The shared pathways are ubiquitin-proteasome degradation and its regulation (degron rules, ERAD, deubiquitinases, protein destabilization), the proteasomal arm of protein quality control that works alongside aggrephagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy to clear misfolded proteins.

theme: RAS-MAPK signalling downstream of FGF receptors
core_role: The shared pathways are the RAS-ERK relay and its brakes (RAS GAPs and NF1, SOS/SHC adaptors, ERK inactivation, phosphatases, negative feedback, oncogenic RAS/MAP2K mutants), the core cascade through which FGFR and RAF signals reach ERK.

theme: Membrane transport of carboxylate metabolites
core_role: The shared pathways are sodium-coupled transport of di- and tricarboxylates such as succinate and citrate, the TCA-intermediate part of organic anion and metabolite transport (e.g. in proximal tubule) alongside pyruvate, monocarboxylate and carnitine carriers.

theme: E2F-driven G1/S cell cycle transcription
core_role: The shared pathways are the E2F transcription network promoting the G1/S transition, the transcriptional switch (and its repression by E2F6, DREAM and pocket proteins) that licenses DNA replication and cell cycle progression.

theme: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and collateral branching
core_role: The shared pathways are axon chemorepulsion, limits on axon extension and collateral sprouting in sensory (DRG) neurons, framed as how netrin guidance cues shape axon growth and branching.

theme: Telomere maintenance via replication and recombination
core_role: The shared pathways are DNA topology remodelling, replication fork reversal and strand elongation control, used here as the fork-processing machinery that replicates telomeres and resolves telomeric D-loops and recombination intermediates.

theme: Mitochondrial gene expression: RNA processing and translation
core_role: The shared pathways are mitochondrial mRNA processing, modification and stability plus mitoribosome large-subunit assembly, the post-transcriptional steps linking mtDNA expression to mitochondrial translation.

theme: Anaphase spindle midzone and cytokinesis
core_role: The shared pathways are anaphase spindle mechanics (spindle elongation, midzone assembly, kinetochore attachment), framed as the structure that positions and signals Rho GTPase-driven cytokinesis.

theme: Chromatin assembly and histone acetylation
core_role: The shared pathways are histone and protein acetylation and nucleosome assembly and remodelling, chromatin organization coupled to DNA replication and repair, with heterochromatin formation in senescence as the wider context.

theme: Apoptosis via extrinsic death receptors and mitochondria
core_role: The shared pathways are death-receptor (Fas, TRAIL, TNF, TLR3/TRIF) caspase-8 signalling and its regulation (c-FLIP, necroptosis), the extrinsic initiating arm that feeds via BID into mitochondrial permeabilization and caspase execution.

theme: M-CSF signalling in monocyte-macrophage development
core_role: The shared pathways are CSF1/M-CSF receptor and related interleukin signalling that drives macrophage proliferation and survival, the growth-factor input into monocyte, macrophage and dendritic cell differentiation.

theme: mRNA 3'-end processing and translation-coupled mRNA surveillance
core_role: The shared pathways are cleavage and polyadenylation defining mature mRNA 3' ends, framed by how translation termination and nonsense/non-stop decay judge and degrade mRNAs.

theme: Platelet activation and integrin signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are integrin adhesion signalling via Rap1, talin, p130Cas, GRB2:SOS and cytoskeletal remodelling, the adhesion and spreading machinery of activated platelets downstream of thrombin, ADP, GPVI and thromboxane receptors (hemostasis).

theme: Viral attachment, entry and host-pathway hijacking
core_role: The shared pathways are SARS coronavirus targeting of host junctional PDZ proteins and signalling, the host-manipulation side of viral infection alongside attachment, entry and fusion of diverse viruses.

theme: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein metabolism: chylomicrons and VLDL
core_role: The shared pathways are VLDL and chylomicron assembly, lipase-mediated remodelling and clearance, the plasma processing of dietary and hepatic triglyceride carriers following intestinal lipid absorption.

theme: Inflammasome and IL-1 inflammatory regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are negative regulation of IL-1 and IL-12 production and of IL-1/Toll signalling, the restraining side of inflammasome-driven IL-1 inflammation.

theme: miRNA-mediated post-transcriptional gene silencing
core_role: The shared pathways are control of miRNA processing and turnover and miRNA regulation of specific mRNA translation (CDH1, CDH11, NPAS4, PD-L1), the regulatory and target-level layer of small-RNA silencing.

theme: Th1 differentiation and IL-12/IFN-gamma response
core_role: The shared pathways are Th1 effector cytokine production (IFN-gamma, IL-12, GM-CSF), the output of Th1 polarization driven by IL-12/STAT signalling and feeding IFN-gamma signalling.

theme: Early embryonic axis and neural plate patterning
core_role: The shared pathways are neural plate regionalization and neuroepithelial differentiation, the neural patterning outcome of embryonic axis specification and neural plate border formation.

theme: Wnt control of mesenchymal stem cells and osteoblasts
core_role: The shared pathways are Wnt signalling driving mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation, the progenitor commitment step upstream of osteoblast proliferation and differentiation (bone formation).

theme: Toll-like receptor-driven inflammatory cytokine production
core_role: The shared pathways are regulation of TLR3/TLR4 signalling and induction of IL-6, IL-8 and TNF, the inflammatory cytokine output of TLR signalling through TRIF/MyD88, TAK1 and IKK.

theme: Rhesus glycoproteins in erythrocyte ammonium/CO2 transport
core_role: The shared pathways are the erythrocyte Rh/RHAG membrane complex and its deficiency, framed as a gas and ammonium transmembrane channel.

theme: Betaglycan (TGFBR3) modulation of TGF-beta signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are TGFBR3 coreceptor function and its post-translational regulation, presenting and modulating TGF-beta (and FGF2) ligands upstream of SMAD signalling and its downregulation.

theme: Erythrocyte gas transport, iron and heme homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways are erythrocyte and iron-handling membrane transport (O2/CO2 exchange, Rh ammonium transport, transferrin and iron uptake/export, heme scavenging), the supply side that supports heme biosynthesis and erythropoiesis.

theme: MHC antigen processing and presentation
core_role: The shared pathways are general antigen processing and presentation including CD1/MHC-Ib lipid presentation, framed within MHC class II presentation of exogenous antigens by B cells and other APCs.

theme: Endocrine control of body growth: leptin, GH, IGF
core_role: The shared pathways are leptin signalling and positive and negative regulation of organism growth, read as part of the GH/JAK-STAT/IGF somatotropic axis.

theme: Plasma lipoprotein metabolism and remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways are LDL and HDL remodelling, the intravascular reshaping of cholesterol-carrying lipoproteins downstream of chylomicron and VLDL assembly, lipolysis and clearance.

theme: Aquaporin and vasopressin-regulated water balance
core_role: The shared pathways are aquaglyceroporin and urea channel permeation of glycerol and urea, the solute-transport side of aquaporins read alongside vasopressin-regulated renal water reabsorption.

theme: Renal water and salt homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways are vasopressin-aquaporin renal water reabsorption and antidiuresis, the water arm of body fluid osmoregulation alongside renal sodium, potassium and chloride transport.

theme: Nucleotide-sugar transport and congenital glycosylation disorders
core_role: The shared pathways are defects of the Golgi CMP-sialic acid and GDP-fucose transporters causing CDG, framed as failures of nucleotide-sugar supply to the Golgi for glycosylation.

theme: Thyroid hormone synthesis and anion transport
core_role: The shared pathways are iodide uptake via NIS and thyroid hormone generation and transport, the hormonogenesis core that relies on pendrin/SLC26 anion exchange and H2O2 for iodide organification.

theme: Leukocyte adhesion and transendothelial migration
core_role: The shared pathways are neutrophil migration, extravasation and diapedesis, the transendothelial migration step enabled by integrin and PECAM1-mediated leukocyte adhesion.

theme: Dopaminergic neurotransmission, reward and psychostimulant response
core_role: The shared pathways are catecholamine synthesis and presynaptic reuptake (DAT, NET), the supply and clearance that set synaptic dopamine and norepinephrine, framing dopamine receptor signalling, behaviour and psychostimulant responses.

theme: Notch signalling transcriptional output
core_role: The shared pathways are Notch target-gene transcription (HES/HEY-type HLH output), the nuclear readout of NICD signalling across Notch paralogs, oncogenic mutants and developmental contexts such as Th2 and pancreatic differentiation.

theme: Neuroendocrine hormone control of growth and stress
core_role: The shared pathways are cytokine-class hormone receptor signalling (GH, prolactin, leptin, IGF) via JAK-STAT that regulates body growth, set alongside the HPA glucocorticoid axis.

theme: NF-kappaB activation and regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are canonical IKK recruitment downstream of TLR/IL-1R (IRAK1) and TNFR1 (RIP1), the core activation step of NF-kappaB signalling framed alongside noncanonical NF-kappaB, ubiquitin control and negative regulation.

theme: Viral replication cycle and host restriction
core_role: The shared pathways are the HIV early life cycle (entry, uncoating, reverse transcription, nuclear import, integration) and host control of viral transcription and latency, the replication phase that host restriction factors and immune evasion act upon.

theme: Ion transport in acid-base balance and mineralization
core_role: The shared pathways are SLC4 bicarbonate transport (AE1, NBCe1) and its disease defects, framed as ion transport for acid-base handling and pH control that supports tissue mineralization alongside phosphate and calcium transporters.

theme: Glycolysis and its regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are glycolytic flux from glucose to lactate and its fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control (with erythrocyte context), the core glycolytic pathway regulated in balance with the pentose phosphate shunt.

theme: Oxidative stress responses and cell death
core_role: The shared pathways are cellular responses to peroxides, ischemia and oxygen stress, the oxidative insult that triggers or is countered by regulation of intrinsic apoptosis.
